svg.text: What I bring to a team

g.text: Pair up, unblock others, share the win.
Set direction, keep the team calm and moving.
Clear updates, kind reviews, no surprises.
— lo-fi while I code, everything else while I don't.
— slice-of-life to shonen. one more episode.
— co-op nights, boss fights, chasing high scores.
